type Point
  x:f64
  y:f64
  norm2 = self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y
  mut move dx:f64, dy:f64>void
    self.x += dx
    self.y += dy
main>void
  n := argi(0)
  seed := f64(argi(1))
  p := Point(seed, seed)
  start := clock()
  i := 0
  while i < n
    p.move(0.25, 0.5)
    i += 1
  result := p.norm2()
  elapsed := clock() - start
  print(result)
  print(elapsed)

particle/glyph.source:
type Point
  x:f64
  y:f64
  norm2 = self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y
  mut move dx:f64, dy:f64>void
    self.x += dx
    self.y += dy
type Particle
  position:Point
  velocity:Point
  norm2 = self.position.norm2()
  mut step>void
    self.position.move(self.velocity.x, self.velocity.y)
main>void
  n := argi(0)
  repeats := argi(1)
  seed := argi(2)
  a := fill(n, Particle(Point(0.0, 0.0), Point(0.25, 0.5)))
  i := 0
  while i < n
    a[i].position = Point(f64(i % 97 + seed), f64(i % 89 + seed))
    i += 1
  checksum := 0.0
  start := clock()
  r := 0
  while r < repeats
    i = 0
    while i < n
      a[i].step()
      checksum += a[i].norm2()
      i += 1
    r += 1
  elapsed := clock() - start
  print(checksum)
  print(elapsed)
